lines.trans: Good afternoon, welcome to the restaurant!
Hello, is that your girlfriend?
Alisa, behave decently with the guests.
I had a grandfather in Novorossiysk.
But he died last year.
And here at last is your dad!
Dad, let us go play with me quickly!
First I will check our cooks' work.
Put less Parmesan into this dish!
The sauce was ordered a whole half-hour ago.
Move faster, the guests have been waiting long for the order.
Dad always commands so loudly.
Your dad is the true master of the kitchen.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
polite, or to several people; the first в is silent

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Напиши: трус не играет в хоккей.
examples.trans: Write: a coward doesn't play hockey.
The children are playing in the courtyard.

examples.text: Мы создадим идеальную команду для работы.
examples.trans: We will create an ideal team for work.

examples.text: Сегодня стояла идеальная погода для прогулки.
examples.trans: Today there was ideal weather for a walk.

meanings.note: не клади трубку = don't hang up

examples.trans: Where do you put the keys?

meanings.en: to command, be in charge, give orders

examples.text: Да я на всё готов! Командуйте.
examples.trans: Why, I'm ready for anything! Give the orders.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: два года назад = two years ago

examples.text: Я их ещё два года назад им выделил!
examples.trans: I allocated it to them two years ago!

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: declines like a feminine noun in -а, but is masculine

examples.trans: Put less Parmesan in the dish.

meanings.en: to come, arrive (idiomatic in добро пожаловать = welcome)

examples.text: Добро пожаловать в наш новый дом!

examples.trans: The guests arrived right at lunchtime.
The sauce was ordered half an hour ago.

meanings.note: по порядку = in order; всё в порядке = everything is fine

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

meanings.en: to check, to test, to verify

examples.text: В прошлый раз я думала, война началась.
examples.trans: Last time I thought a war had started.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!
First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Паста под соусом была очень вкусной.
examples.trans: The pasta with sauce was very tasty.
The chef prepared a spicy tomato sauce.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: person who owns a business or property

examples.trans: The owner of the restaurant came out into the dining room.

examples.text: Я не могу гулять здесь целый день.
examples.trans: I can't walk around here all day.
We waited for a whole hour.

шевелиться.gloss: to move, to get a move on

meanings.en: to move, to stir; colloquial: get a move on

examples.trans: Move faster, the guests are waiting for the order.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
